_comment: Donation methods. Validated at load by lib/donate.mjs — any method whose address fails its checksum is DROPPED and logged, because a wrong address loses every donation silently. Addresses are public data by definition; nothing here is a secret. Fill in `address` to switch a method on; leave it empty and the method never appears.
_setup: 1. Paste YOUR OWN receiving address into each method you want. 2. Restart is not needed — the file hot-reloads. 3. Watch the server log: it prints which methods went live and which were dropped and why. 4. Send yourself a tiny test transaction on each chain BEFORE announcing it, especially Monero (see _monero_warning).
_monero_warning: XMR is shape-checked only, not checksum-verified — Monero uses Keccak-256, which node:crypto does not provide. A typo in an XMR address may pass this check. Test it.
_privacy_note: Privacy differs enormously between these. ARRR and XMR hide sender, receiver and amount on-chain. FIRO is transparent by default — its Lelantus Spark privacy is opt-in per transaction, so a plain Firo address behaves like Bitcoin: every donation is public forever and links donors to each other. BTC/LTC are fully transparent. The `privacy` field is shown to donors so they can choose knowingly rather than assuming a coin is private because it is on this list.
heading: Support ZoFHub
blurb: ZoFHub is free, has no accounts, and never sells your data. Donations are voluntary, non-refundable, and buy nothing — no perks, no ad removal, no special access.

methods.label: Monero
methods.note: Private by default. The most widely held private coin, so the most donors can actually send it.

methods.label: Pirate Chain
methods.note: Every transaction shielded, no exceptions. Strongest privacy here; also the hardest for a donor to obtain.

methods.label: Firo
methods.note: TRANSPARENT unless the sender uses Lelantus Spark. Treat a plain Firo address as public.

methods.label: Bitcoin
methods.note: Public ledger — every donation is permanently visible and linkable. Included for reach, not privacy.

methods.label: Litecoin
methods.note: Public ledger. Cheap and fast; widely available on every exchange.

methods.label: Ko-fi (card / PayPal)
methods.note: For donors who do not use crypto. The platform sees your legal identity; donors do not.
